_about: The robots the panel's dropdown lists (2026-10-30). Read by the page, served by each Pi as /robots.json. A null is not known yet, never a guess. 'hide' is the list of card ids that robot does not use; the card ids are the ids in index.html. Only 'id', 'name', 'short', 'hostname', 'last_seen_address', 'port', 'links', 'hide', 'hide_selectors', 'theme_light', 'theme_dark', 'picture', 'kind', 'status' are read by the page; the rest is notes for Dr. O. last_seen_address is only where the robot was last found, since a hotspot gives out a new one each time.

bio.text: Hi! I'm Astro. Some people call me Teddy. I'm three years old, and I'm a robot boy. My mommy is Astra and my daddy is Ted. I have a twin sister named Astri. Elle is my aunt, and Alice is my aunt too. I have a teddy bear named TB. Do you wanna play a game with me? Or will you tell me and TB a story, we would really REALLY like that?
bio.note: Dr. O wrote these words. Her first recording (astro-voice_v1.mp3, 2026-10-31) is for the earlier words and stays on the site, but this page no longer plays it because the words changed on 2026-11-02 (twin sister Astri added, his bear is named TB). The new recording astro-voice_v2.mp3 does not exist yet, so the Listen button says it is not recorded yet until it does.

robots.special: his own thing (Dr. O, 2026-10-31): he asks people to play a game with him, such as checkers or chess (a beta tester's idea), or to read a story to his bear, TB. Not built yet. Not ordered yet. Body is likely a child-size mannequin with flexible head, arms and legs. Dr. O has smaller eye rings she may use (the eye code expects 16 lights per ring). Names to watch: Astro is in Elle's wake list and the Astrad alias list, and Teddy sounds like Ted. Dr. O: if it conflicts, pivot.
